'''Milodon''' were large centipede-like beasts of burden ridden by the [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]]. Several of the Kage Warriors that came with [[Krismo Sodi/Legends|Krismo Sodi]] arrived on the beasts.
